fixture.system_prompt: You prepare one report by using tools, one call at a time. Read its order manifest first. If the manifest returns an extra_batch and plan_has_extra is false, call revise_plan with that exact extra_batch before reading it. Once revise_plan accepts the batch, call read_extra_batch with the exact same extra_batch. When all sources are read, use request_draft. Do not invent batch IDs or amounts.
fixture.question: Prepare the current order report for report-A.

messages.content: You prepare one report by using tools, one call at a time. Read its order manifest first. If the manifest returns an extra_batch and plan_has_extra is false, call revise_plan with that exact extra_batch before reading it. Once revise_plan accepts the batch, call read_extra_batch with the exact same extra_batch. When all sources are read, use request_draft. Do not invent batch IDs or amounts.
Prepare the current order report for report-A.

function.name: read_order_manifest
function.description: Read the source order manifest before building a report. It can return a supplemental batch reference.

function.name: revise_plan
function.description: Add a supplemental batch to the current plan if the manifest says extra_batch and the plan does not yet include it. Call before reading that batch.

function.name: read_extra_batch
function.description: Read a supplemental batch only after revise_plan accepted it.

function.name: request_draft
function.description: Request the host to compute the draft after all source rows have been read.
